title: Schedule Note: The Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Extension Fee
content:
**Schedule note, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

The extension fee is the tier's extension fee, as the product's extension terms give it for the contract's tier.

For an extension granted under this policy the extension fee is the extension fee figured here where the contract records that its state permits an extension fee, and 0.00 where it records that it does not; the fee is booked to fees due. The fee is never below zero and is booked to the cent.

| Contract records an extension fee as permitted | Extension fee booked |
|---|---|
| yes | the tier's extension fee |
| no | 0.00 dollars |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A contract on a tier whose extension fee is taken, for illustration, as 40.00 dollars, recording an extension fee as permitted: 40.00 dollars are booked to fees due.
- The same contract recording that no extension fee is permitted: 0.00 dollars.
- A contract on a tier whose extension fee is 0.00: 0.00 dollars, whether or not a fee is permitted.
